parameters.text:
={{ `Analyze this AI article for a daily learning digest.

Title:
${$json.title}

Description:
${$json.description}

Return ONLY valid JSON with exactly this structure:

{
  "what_it_does": "Explain the main technical idea of the paper in 1-2 concise sentences using clear language.",
  "why_it_matters": "Explain in 1-2 concise sentences why this paper is useful or interesting for someone learning or working in AI/ML/software engineering. Do not simply repeat what the paper does.",
  "category": "one short category",
  "relevance_score": 0,
  "learning_score": 0,
  "novelty_score": 0,
  "key_takeaways": [
    "takeaway 1",
    "takeaway 2"
  ]
}

Scoring rules:
- relevance_score: 0-10, importance for AI/ML/software engineering
- learning_score: 0-10, usefulness for someone learning AI/ML/software engineering
- novelty_score: 0-10, how new or distinctive the idea appears

Writing rules:
- what_it_does should explain the contribution itself.
- why_it_matters should explain why the reader should care.
- Avoid vague phrases such as "this paper is important because it advances AI".
- Be specific and concrete.
- Do not include markdown.
- Do not include any text before or after the JSON.` }}

parameters.jsCode:
const analysis = $json;
const original = $('Receive Article for Analysis').first().json;

return {
  json: {
    title: original.title,
    url: original.url,
    source: original.source,
    published_at: original.published_at,

    arxiv_id: original.arxiv_id || "",

    original_url:
      original.original_url ||
      original.url ||
      "",

    quick_read_url:
      original.quick_read_url ||
      original.url ||
      "",

    featured_on_huggingface:
      original.featured_on_huggingface ?? false,

    what_it_does: analysis.what_it_does || "",
    why_it_matters: analysis.why_it_matters || "",

    category: analysis.category || "",

    relevance_score: analysis.relevance_score ?? 0,
    learning_score: analysis.learning_score ?? 0,
    novelty_score: analysis.novelty_score ?? 0,

    key_takeaways: analysis.key_takeaways || [],

    valid_json: analysis.valid_json ?? false,
    deterministic_score: original.deterministic_score
  }
};
